subject: Confidential intake: potential retaliation reported after performance conversation
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Confidential: urgent intake — possible retaliation after review

Naomi, Monica —

I need to escalate a concern that came up after yesterday's performance discussion with Samantha Lane (IC, onboarding QA). Samantha sent me a note this morning alleging that after I delivered her review and the associated PIP suggestion, her manager (external to this thread) threatened to remove her remote privileges and implied consequences if she "pushed back." She is worried this is retaliation and asked for the conversation to be escalated.

Attached: Samantha's written statement (s_lane_statement.pdf) and the performance notes I had from the 5/20 discussion (performance_notes_2026-05-20.txt). Samantha has asked for confidentiality and asked that I not discuss the matter with the manager until HR reviews.

As her skip, I want to make sure we preserve everything and avoid any actions that could look like escalation from my side. Can you confirm next steps? Do we need to put a hold on any personnel actions pending intake?

I copied Marcus in case legal should be looped early.

Thanks,
Rishi

Rishi Malhotra
Engineering Manager, Core Serving
Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0189

Attachments: s_lane_statement.pdf (pdf), performance_notes_2026-05-20.txt (text)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confidential: urgent intake — possible retaliation after review

Rishi —

Thanks for the prompt heads up and for preserving Samantha's statement. I reviewed the attachments. Next steps (short):

- Do not confront the manager or take any escalation actions yourself. Preserve the status quo (no role changes, no revocation of remote privileges) until intake is complete.
- Do not share the attachments outside this small group. Treat them as confidential.
- Monica will run a formal intake and open an HR intake ticket; she will coordinate a private interview with Samantha within 48 hours.
- Marcus, please confirm whether we should loop outside counsel now. If legal prefers to triage privately, copy outside-legal@barneslaw.com.

I am attaching a short confidentiality reminder template you can send to the immediate team if appropriate. I'll take lead on the intake and will be the point investigator for now.

Please confirm you've paused any actions that would materially affect Samantha's role/pay/status. Also, Rishi — retain any Slack threads, calendar events, and 1:1 notes related to the review; Monica will request them via the intake ticket.

Naomi Feldman
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference
aomi_feldman@redwood.com

Attachment: confidentiality_reminder_template.docx

Thanks — confirmed. I have not taken any adverse actions. I reached back out to Samantha for clarification and she provided a short audio summary; she asked that I include it in the intake. I've converted her notes to PDF and attached a manager follow-up summary (manager_followup_summary.pdf) that outlines the timeline: 5/20 review, 5/24 follow-up calibration, 5/25 escalation note.

If HR wants me to do anything differently (e.g., collect Slack threads formally), let me know and I'll follow the intake checklist. I'm keeping all materials in a private folder and haven't shared them with the manager or the broader team.

Rishi

Subject: HR intake opened: Samantha Lane — immediate plan and owners

Team —

I opened HR intake HRINT-482 and uploaded the files to the confidential drive folder. Summary and owners below: 

- Intake summary: Samantha Lane alleges retaliatory remarks linked to a recent performance conversation and is requesting confidentiality and a neutral fact-finding review.
- Intake owner: Monica Patel (HR) — intake meeting scheduled 2026-05-26 15:00 PT (private).
- Investigator: Naomi Feldman (People Ops) — will lead fact-finding and determine next steps.
- Legal review: Marcus Lin / outside counsel (looped) — please advise on any immediate legal cautionary steps.
- Manager actions: Rishi confirmed no adverse changes have been taken; please maintain that status.
- Evidence requested: Rishi please upload Slack export, calendar invites, and 1:1 notes to the intake folder prior to the meeting. Samantha has consented to an interview; do not share details with the manager.

Timeline: Intake meeting today; preliminary assessment by 5/29; if substantiated, we will propose interim measures and notify leadership. If anyone needs to escalate or has additional evidence, reply only to this thread or upload to the secure drive link.

Thanks — I will update HRINT-482 with notes after today's intake.

Monica Patel
Senior HR Business Partner
